notes: Children are PkSortableItem. pk-sortable never reorders its own children (SDK rule: the element owns its shadow tree, the host owns the light DOM), so OnReorder is the whole contract: handle it and re-render ChildContent in EventArgs.Order (or, when EventArgs.External is true, insert the new item at EventArgs.To), the way any controlled list works. Reference the same primitive from JS with beginExternalDrag / externalDragOver / endExternalDrag for a palette-to-canvas drop.
